brief.claim: Prenatal exposure raises adult open-field activity: the mean activity score of offspring of exposed dams is higher than that of offspring of control dams, and a two-sample t test of the difference between the two group means gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: open-field activity score (distance travelled, arbitrary units) measured in adulthood on each pup of each dam
whether the dam received the exposure during pregnancy

brief.sizes: dams = 20; pups = 8 (activity: 20 x 8 = 160 values; exposed: 20 values)
